title: Gaussian invariance under paired reflection
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\theta\in\mathbb R$. For independent vectors $z,w\in\mathbb R^n$ with the product standard Gaussian law, the map sending $(z,w)$ to the pair whose coordinates are $((\cos\theta)z_i+(\sin\theta)w_i)_{i=1}^n$ and $((\sin\theta)z_i-(\cos\theta)w_i)_{i=1}^n$ preserves that product law.
